title: Extended Matrix Multiplication Tensor Rank over F₂ (26 Open Shapes, up to 6×6×6)
description: Twenty-six formally verified open matrix multiplication tensor-rank hill-climb challenges over F₂ spanning ⟨2,4,5⟩ through ⟨6,6,6⟩ (zero overlap with `matrix-rank444-f2` or `matrix-rank-alphatensor-f2`). Implemented in pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) with a formalized bilinear matrix-multiplication soundness theorem and bit-packed Brent-equation `decide +kernel` verifier (<2s per track), anchored to verified MIT-licensed ternary/F₂ baselines from `dronperminov/FastMatrixMultiplication@f70078cd`.

tasks.title: Reduce ⟨2,4,5⟩ rank over F₂ below 34
tasks.description: Improve the verified F₂ bilinear rank bound for ⟨2,4,5⟩ matrix multiplication (ZT/F₂ seed 34 (Q literature: 32); all 1,600 Brent equations kernel-verified in pure Lean 4.36.0 with zero Mathlib). Submit bitmask triples in `RankF2Ext/Cert2x4x5.lean` (`RankF2Ext.score_2_4_5` and `RankF2Ext.cert_2_4_5`).
